001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004
005/**
006 * Stores a private collection of items keyed by name.
007 *
008 * <p>The internal collection is fully encapsulated and cannot be manipulated directly from outside
009 * this class.
010 *
011 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
012 * @version 2026.04.13
013 */
014public class ItemList {
015    /** Internal storage keyed by item name. */
016    private HashMap<String, Item> aItems;
017
018    /** Creates an empty item list. */
019    public ItemList() {
020        this.aItems = new HashMap<String, Item>();
021    } // ItemList()
022
023    /**
024     * Returns the item associated with the given name, or {@code null}.
025     *
026     * @param pName the lookup key
027     * @return the matching {@link Item}, or {@code null}
028     */
029    public Item getItem(final String pName) {
030        return this.aItems.get(pName);
031    } // getItem()
032
033    /**
034     * Returns the backing item map.
035     *
036     * @return item keys mapped to item objects
037     */
038    public HashMap<String, Item> getAllItems() {
039        return this.aItems;
040    } // getAllItems()
041
042    /**
043     * Adds or replaces an item under the given key.
044     *
045     * @param pName short identifier used for later retrieval
046     * @param pItem the {@link Item} to store
047     */
048    public void addItem(final String pName, final Item pItem) {
049        this.aItems.put(pName, pItem);
050    } // addItem()
051
052    /**
053     * Removes the item associated with the given key.
054     *
055     * @param pName the lookup key
056     */
057    public void removeItem(final String pName) {
058        this.aItems.remove(pName);
059    } // removeItem()
060
061    /**
062     * Checks whether this item list contains no elements.
063     *
064     * @return {@code true} when no items are stored
065     */
066    public boolean isEmpty() {
067        return this.aItems.isEmpty();
068    } // isEmpty()
069
070    /**
071     * Builds a multi-line string with each item's description, or a default notice when the list is
072     * empty.
073     *
074     * @return formatted item descriptions
075     */
076    public String getItemsDescription() {
077        if (this.aItems.isEmpty()) {
078            return "There are no items here!";
079    }
080        String vResult = "";
081        for (String vName : this.aItems.keySet()) {
082            vResult += this.aItems.get(vName).getItemDescription() + "\n";
083        }
084        return vResult;
085    } // getItemsDescription()
086
087    /**
088     * Builds an inventory summary listing all item keys and the total value.
089     *
090     * @return formatted inventory text suitable for printing to the UI
091     */
092    public String getItemList() {
093        if (this.aItems.isEmpty()) {
094            return "You don't have any items!" + "\n";
095    }
096        String vResult = "Your items: ";
097        int vInventoryPrice = 0;
098        for (String vItem : this.aItems.keySet()) {
099            vResult += " " + vItem;
100            vInventoryPrice += this.aItems.get(vItem).getItemPrice();
101        }
102        vResult += "\n\nTotal value: " + vInventoryPrice;
103        return vResult;
104    } // getItemList()
105} // ItemList
